detail.title: Evaluation of Path Dependence in Value Divergence
detail.summary: Following the invalid measurement in experiment exp-divergent-values-test-70, this cycle initiates a re-evaluation of experimental stability. Rather than adjusting feedback intensity, the next direction pivots toward parameter initialization robustness to address underlying numerical instability, while continuing to investigate the hypothesis that path-dependent value divergence is a measurable property of the system.
